# Pinned boltons math utilities

This fixture retains the complete upstream `boltons/mathutils.py` and BSD-3-Clause
license without modification from the boltons 25.0.0 commit
`c23dbdadb6fecdf505eb4231559561913b84c13f`. `provenance.json` records immutable
upstream source URLs, exact SHA-256 hashes and byte lengths. Git attributes keep
source and license bytes unchanged on checkout.

Only `source/` is a baseline product root. Keep the license and provenance with
the corpus distribution. The trusted native/independent runner, expected cases,
fixed profile and explicit dependency instructions are outside that root at
`benchmarks/profiles/pilot/`; see its README. Source authorship provenance is
unknown; this fixture establishes harness behavior, not skill effectiveness.
